jobs.name: paper_trade_watchdog
jobs.prompt:
Check paper trade simulator status. Run: ~/paper_trade/start.sh status

If status shows NOT running, restart with: ~/paper_trade/start.sh start

If running, just confirm. Read ~/paper_trade/status.md and report total equity and any new trades since last check.

Keep output short.
